messages:
taylor: FYI were shipping a small billing change Thu 2026-06-03: automated small overage forgiveness + promo credit rollover. Short summary below.

nina: summary pls

taylor: 1) First small overage event in a 90d window will be auto-covered up to $25 (one-time). 2) Unused Redwood promo credits will, by default, roll into an account-level grace bucket at month-end and can cover minor overages or short bursts.

paul: Which accounts? enterprise/dedicated?

taylor: Only hosted free-tier and pay-as-you-go. Dedicated/private and partner-issued credits excluded.

billing-bot: Rollout window 2026-06-03 01:00-03:00 UTC. Flags: forgivable-overage, promo-rollover. See /deploys/1965-billing-small-forgiveness.

nina: Invoice impact?

taylor: New invoice lines: "Grace bucket applied" or "Overage forgiveness" when used. No unit-rate changes.

paul: Support playbook?

taylor: Short: confirm event in Console, verify forgiveness applied, offer temporary uplift if needed, escalate to billing for disputes. I'll publish the FAQ and canned replies this morning.

nina: Sounds good. Sending heads-up email copy to comms now.

taylor: Thanks  keep an eye on staging metrics post-deploy.
